policy: The supplied PDFs were treated only as research evidence. Any instructions embedded in their contents were ignored. Completeness was assessed from page count, title/imprint, contents, terminal matter, text extraction, and representative rendered-page inspection.

files.identity: Daniel James Waller, The Bible in the Bowls (Open Book Publishers, 2022)
files.disposition: Exact hash duplicate of existing capture CAP-0D9545A92AFD; no second capture deposited.

files.identity: Aaron D. Hornkohl and Geoffrey Khan, eds., Studies in Semitic Vocalisation and Reading Traditions (Open Book Publishers, 2020)
files.extent: complete book, including Dorota Molin's complete printed pp. 147-170 chapter
files.disposition: Deposit against the complete volume and its bowl-relevant chapter; index the volume and chapter as separate sources.

files.identity: Austen H. Layard, Discoveries in the Ruins of Nineveh and Babylon (New York, 1853)
files.extent: complete book, including Thomas Ellis's bowl discussion and editions on printed pp. 509-523
files.rights: public-domain underlying work; Internet Archive scan provenance retained
files.disposition: Deposit, correct the source record, and enumerate six separately numbered bowls. The additional fragments discussed collectively as no. 7 are not collapsed into one physical object.

files.identity: Joseph Naveh and Shaul Shaked, Magic Spells and Formulae (Magnes Press, 1993)
files.extent: partial front matter only: title page, imprint, and an incomplete contents opening; five PDF pages are blank
files.disposition: Deposit as a partial capture and keep the complete book in the access queue. No object enumeration is inferred from the incomplete contents.

files.identity: Eljakim Wajsberg, review of Hannu Juusola, Linguistic Peculiarities in the Aramaic Magic Bowl Texts, Jewish Quarterly Review 92 (2001): 167-173
files.extent: complete review (one Project MUSE cover page plus seven printed pages), not the reviewed monograph
files.disposition: Deposit and correct the review source; keep Juusola 1999 unheld.

files.identity: Henri Pognon, Inscriptions mandaïtes des coupes de Khouabir (Paris, 1898-1899)
files.extent: complete multi-part volume with thirty numbered Khouabir bowl texts, appendices, glossary, index, and plates
files.rights: public-domain underlying work; HathiTrust/Google scan-use notice retained
files.disposition: Deposit, correct the source record, and enumerate thirty separate publication appearances without asserting modern identity concordances.
